system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

You are clad in flesh hardened by the pressures of the deep and perseverance. You gain resistance to Chakra and Cold Damage. Also, when you are hit with a Critical Hit, you gain a Will of Fire.

Additionally, while in your Apex Predator state, you gain immunity to Cold Damage, and you have advantage on saving throws made to resist the Bleed, Dazed and Stunned conditions.
